skills.name: Spirit of Phoenix
skills.description: Share Phoenix's spirit and yours. There is a chance that the Spirit of Phoenix will expand when being attacked. Additional effects appear as it expands.

skills.name: Flame Archon
skills.description: Receives the will of the phoenix to drastically increase the fighting ability of party members. For 1 minute, increases Resistance to de-buff attacks by 40%, P. Def. by 50%, M. Def. by 50%, Atk. Spd. by 30%, Accuracy by 6, Speed by 30, and Resistance to buff canceling attacks by 40%. Decreases the effectiveness of received recovery magic by 80% . When a sword is equipped, increases Critical Rate by 100. When a blunt is equipped, increases Critical Damage by 100%.

skills.name: Eva's Will
skills.description: Show Will of Eva through yourself. There is a chance that the Will of Eva will expand when being attacked. Additional effects appear with growth.

skills.name: Touch of Eva
skills.description: Restores HP of party members by 50%. For 1 minute, increases Resistance to buff cancel attacks by 100% and the power of received HP recovery magic by 30%. Restores 50 HP every second.

skills.name: Pain of Shilen
skills.description: Shilen's pain becomes your own. Shilen's suffering wracks your body, having a chance to increase when you are being attacked. Additional effects appear with each increase. When level 3 is achieved, you can then use the Spirit of Shilen.

skills.name: Spirit of Shilen
skills.description: Receives the will of Shilen to drastically increase the fighting ability of party members. For 1 minute, increases P. Atk. by 30%, Speed by 30, Atk. Spd. by 30%, Critical Rate when a sword is equipped by 100, and Critical Damage when a blunt weapon is equipped by 100%. Recovers as HP 40% of standard melee damage inflicted on the enemy. Decreases the power of received HP recovery magic by 80%.

skills.name: Wild Shot
skills.description: Fires bolt at random to attack enemies in front with 7475 Power added to P. Atk. Requires a crossbow. Over-hit and Critical are possible. Increases Power upon the consumption of up to 5 souls.

skills.name: Lightning Shock
skills.description: Sends an electric current to attack nearby enemies with 69 Power added to M. Atk. Makes the enemy's body rigid for 5 seconds, then paralyzed for 5 seconds. Increases Power upon the consumption of up to 5 souls.

skills.name: Betrayal Mark
skills.description: Stamps the Mark of Betrayal on the enemy. When attacking the enemy that has the mark, inflicts damage to the enemy's party with a fixed rate.

skills.name: Undead
skills.description: Called out of their graves by black magic, a curse or the power of an evil mind, most of these creatures lack intelligence and can perform only simple actions. However, some high-ranking undead possess great knowledge and sophistication even when compared to ordinary humanoids.

skills.name: Magic Creatures
skills.description: The common name for the biotechnological items of the Magic and Titan Ages. Their M. Atk. is generally strong and they sometimes use high-level magic, such as teleportation.

skills.name: Beasts
skills.description: They are animals who prey on humanoids for food. Some of them are mythological creatures that existed before the origins of humanity.

skills.name: Animals
skills.description: These general animals are hunted by humanoids. They sometimes attack humanoids, but only to defend themselves or their territory.

skills.name: Plants
skills.description: These consist of trees, grasses, mushrooms, and fungi. Instinctual creatures, it is generally impossible to have a conversation with them.

skills.name: Humanoids
skills.description: They have two arms, two legs, and they walk upright. Culture and communal life varies by race.

skills.name: Spirits
skills.description: They are not necessarily creatures, but elemental energy beings.  They basically belong to the 4 elements, which are water, fire, wind, and earth, but they also dwell in natural objects. They are known to be governed by the gods of water, fire, wind, and earth.

skills.name: Angels
skills.description: These creatures of the heavenly realm or the race posses sacred blessings and were originally creatures of the spirits of light. In some very rare cases, angels can manifest the gods' will in reality.

skills.name: Demons
skills.description: This race of darkness opposes the angels. Beings that are changed by the curse of darkness become demons as well.

skills.name: Dragons
skills.description: This word refers to True Dragon that is the most powerful and represents evil creatures Shilen gave birth to and its kinds.  Most of this race flies with two wings like reptiles and emits strong energy through its mouth.

skills.name: Giants
skills.description: This race looks similar to a humanoid, but they are approximately 2-3 times in size. This includes the ancient Giants who once ruled the continent, their descendants, and even the monsters that have regressed and in whom only a small fragment of the race's history remains.

skills.name: Bugs
skills.description: They consist of insects, spiders and worms and act upon their highly refined instincts. Sometimes their instincts present themselves in a more developed form than that of humanoid society.

skills.name: Fairies
skills.description: Many members of this ancient race left our world as it changed to become more hostile. Some scholars theorize that Fairies were actually living works of art created by the gods for their entertainment.

skills.name: Humans
skills.description: The last race created by the gods, Humans won the race war for domination of the entire world. Their strong desire for domination is perhaps fueled by the fact that their life span is the shortest among all the races.

skills.name: Elves
skills.description: This water race worships Eva and love peace. They possess vast knowledge, but lack the will and strength to implement it. The original students of magic, they have since taught its principles to humans.

skills.name: Dark Elves
skills.description: These Elves formed an alliance long ago and dedicated themselves to understanding the dark arts which were forbidden by their kin.  Gradually they became darker in their appearance and personality as generations passed. They are now adept in the practice and usage of black magic and continue to worship Shilen as their God.

skills.name: Orcs
skills.description: Created by Pa'agrio, the Orcs are the physically strongest of all the races. They worship the spirits of the past and have a very tribal culture.

skills.name: Dwarves
skills.description: Although unable to use magic, Dwarves are strong and good with their hands.  They have sharp eyes and intelligent minds. Their business savvy is impressive, and they sometimes invent strange mechanical devices.

skills.name: Siege Weapons
skills.description: These massive Dwarf-made weapons are built to besiege castles.

skills.name: Defending Army
skills.description: The soldiers hired to protect castles; normally hired by a lord.

skills.name: Mercenaries
skills.description: The soldiers hired to attack castles; normally hired by a lord with payment.

skills.name: Unknown Creature
skills.description: An unknown life form that has never been discovered before.

skills.name: Kamael
skills.description: Battle race who have been sealed for a long time, and their origin is unknown. Their military-like classes and unique battle abilities cannot be copied by other races.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 23
skills.description: A soldier of the Convict Mercenaries, who were famous for their bravery during the Aden-Gracia War. Currently, he is the Commander of the Gracian Convict Mercenaries, the surviving remnants of the company left in Aden Kingdom. His soldiers are based in Gludio.  He waits for an opportunity to return to his country.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 30
skills.description: The commander of the Katu Mercenaries. Prone to violent outbursts at any cause, he takes special joy in battling both elves and dark elves. He has no care for personal appearance or common courtesies, and some claim him touched by madness.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 42
skills.description: A wicked Spider that once lived in the Wastelands while Beleth was free. After Beleth was sealed away, the Spider was chased away by a colony of Ants, empowered by the magic power of the Wastelands. The Spider was forced to retreat to this place. It swears that someday it will feed on the Ants and destroy them. It  quietly grows in power while sharpening its fangs for vengeance.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: A Treant who used to live south of Gludio, he loved trees and nature. After the war with Beleth, his beautiful forest home was destroyed, and his friends were slain. Deeply affected by that traumatic loss he is now trapped in a haze of hatred, madness, and the desire for revenge.  Gripped by his anger, he is still at war against all humans and mystics.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 50
skills.description: One of the leaders of the peasants who resisted the merciless rule of Lord Ashton. He was ultimately captured and brutally executed by Ashton's cruel soldiers. Yet even that did not stop him. To overthrow  Ashton, he made a contract with a devil and came back to life. But the devil's bargain turned his once noble ideals towards loathing, turning him into a monster with the power of evil magic.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 60
skills.description: A mechanical golem owned by the Lord of Innadril Castle. The lord's family has been protected by Eva for generations. This golem was created to protect the Garden of Eva, made by a dwarven master artisan. It is a guard to fend off the Water Dragon Fafurion's troops, or invaders threatening the garden. The dwarven master made two other golems, but this third and final one was the strongest.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 25
skills.description: A Pan who was once a long-time friend of the Elves, and guarded the ancient Elven Forest. The Pans stayed neutral during the tragic war between the Elves and the Dark Elves, and both sides turned against them. The other Pans retreated into hiding after suffering cruel attacks from both sides, but Pay Dryad still remains here waiting for the golden age of peace to return.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 34
skills.description: An Orc Dark Mage with superior talent. He was once known as "the Hope of the Breka Orc tribe," but he was tricked into plotting against his leader, and exiled. Now, he dreams of the day he will take vengeance on those who betrayed and exiled him. He grows in power, and uses summoning magic learned from the Dark Elves to harness powerful servitors and minions.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 34
skills.description: She is the Ruthless Queen of Marsh Stakatos, deep in the Cruma Marshlands. The Queen is notorious for  mercilessness and cruelty to both her own forces and enemies alike. She has ordered the deaths of any and all who oppose her, including subordinates and even her own children. The Queen yearns to build a kingdom for Marsh Stakatos someday.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 49
skills.description: He is the Commander of the advance forces of the powerful Ketra Orc tribe, who hail from the Goddard Territory of Elmore Kingdom. He believes completely in the superiority of his tribe. He was dispatched to expand their influence upon Aden Kingdom. He greatly detests the Silenos as well as humans, and is a formidable enemy.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 53
skills.description: A powerful, mutant Monster Eye. Some scholars believe it has achieved the final stage of Monster Eye evolution. It is incredibly intelligent and arrogant. Years ago it ran away from Argos, the father of all Monster Eyes, to the south. It thinks and schemes, and plots to   steal Argos's power someday. It believes that it grows stronger by eating the brains of other intelligent living beings, and so it feeds often.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 58
skills.description: The loyal guardian who protects the Garden of Eva, the resting place of the goddess Eva. Many seasons have passed since Eva's last visit, but he remains to protect the Garden against savages who might wish to despoil the holy goddess's resting place.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: Reaper is the page of the Goddess of Death, Shilen. Reaper is in charge of collecting the countless souls who wander about on earth, and bringing them to the underground world of Shilen. His loyalty to Shilen is absolute, and he stays close to the Seal of Shilen in order to serve the goddess better. He diligently carries out his duty while waiting for the day of the goddess's resurrection.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 28
skills.description: A servant of the Knight Barion, he gained the body of a devil through the dark magic of the Devil Kernon. He has only a growing anger towards General Karte, who made him a devil, and Karte's loyal officer, Barion. What he doesn't know is that this hatred is magical, inflamed  by the schemes of the Devil Kernon.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: The Lord of Marsh Stakatos is under the mental domination of the Devil Rahha. He strengthens the Stakato Army for Rahha. He is the bitter rival of Queen Jeruna of Marsh Stakatos, who lives in the Cruma Marshlands.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 47
skills.description: The Knight of Elmoreden, the Commander of the soldiers studying the Tower of Insolence, under order  of General Karte. As the right arm of General Karte, he is a brave knight willing to go to Hell if ordered, for like the general, he has an immortal body. He received his secret powers from the Devil Rahha, who also warned him to watch Tirak closely.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 49
skills.description: A General of Elmoreden who obtained an immortal body through a pact with the Devil Kernon. Stubborn to a fault, he opposed the construction of the Tower of Insolence. His stance spared him of Einhasad's rage. However, he has lost his king and country. He despises those who betrayed his king and built their own kingdom. As a loyal servant of the empire, he yearns for the day when he may once again find and serve his true king.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 51
skills.description: The Devil Kernon's confidant, he is a feisty and vicious devil. He overpowers his enemies with his immense strength and gigantic body. Currently, he is studying the inside of the Tower of Insolence at Kernon's command. A simple devil warrior, he believes that if he serves his superiors loyally, he will benefit from their promotions.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 65
skills.description: An assistant to the Death Lord Hallate, she is smart  and beautiful. Currently, she works as Devil Kernon's servant, in charge of Tower of Insolence. Yet in truth she is Hallate's confidant and lover. She senses the Devil Kernon's schemes of betrayal, and thus quietly watches him.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 75
skills.description: A servant of the Death Lord Hallate, he collects the secrets hidden in the Tower of Insolence. He aspires to take over Death Lord Hallate's position, for Hallate is exhausted from battling against Baium. He has offered his services to General Karte of Elmoreden.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 45
skills.description: The pet of the brilliant mystic, Sartune of Elmoreden, who was imprisoned due to the jealousy and envy of his rivals. It lives up to Sartune's reputation, and is tremendously smart and playful to the point of cruelty. It causes havoc throughout the back roads through its many minions.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 24
skills.description: A tragic lady transformed into a succubus through a Mystic's curse. She loved a prince of the Waltner family of Gludio, but was tricked into murdering him. Now, she feeds on the energy of travelers in Gludio, delaying her death day by day.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: A Turek Orc leader praised for his powerful soul, bravery, and wisdom. He has retired from the field, and lives in a secluded corner of the Orc Barracks giving counsel to those who seek his advice. Normally reserved, when roused he does not shy away from battle.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: The Lizardman mystic who rules over the Delu Lizardmen with his mighty insight and wisdom. He is said to have studied directly under Hardin. In his youth,  he counseled peace with the humans, but they were blindly hostile despite his peaceful  efforts. He has grown angry over the years at the human stupidity, and has declared war on any and all intruders to his tribe's territory.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 52
skills.description: The leader of the Red Flag of the Oel Mahum, who waits for his opportunity to take over the Bandit Stronghold. He is tremendously proud of being an Oel Mahum. Although smart, hearty and brave, he is still young and is still growing into his power. He boasts that one day he will build a kingdom of Oel Mahums.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: Timitran Guardian who watches over the outer area of Fairy Forest under the command of Queen Timidiel. It hates intruders who disrupt the order of the forest, and it cannot forgive anyone who breaks the laws of the forest. With the power received from Queen Timidiel, it calls Sylph and Unicorn, and it protects Fairy Forest together with them.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 69
skills.description: A creature of the Land Dragon Antharas, entrusted to protect the Dragon Dungeon, and slay any trespassers who might wake the Land Dragon from his deep slumber. His body is stained with the blood of the many intruders he has killed, and so he is called Bloody Priest Rudelto.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 25
skills.description: An unfortunate princess who was turned into a giant toad by the curse of the evil mage Vijay. Princess Molrang was the daughter of the Unification King, Raoul. Her beauty was famed throughout the kingdom. The stories say that the Dark Mage Vijay cursed her because she refused his love.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 30
skills.description: The leader of the most famous bandits in Gludio. He once declared he would steal the most beautiful, immortal, and valuable object in the world, and some say he has been trying to steal the heart of beautiful Poesia ever since.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 39
skills.description: The leader of a gang of cats, all pets long abandoned by their masters. They are known for snatching fresh fish from the very nets of the Fishermen, and the Fish Traders' Association has offered a great bounty for them. Many hunters have tried to catch the cats, but ultimately gave up their chase because the cats were too cute.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 44
skills.description: Taik Orc Chief Ranger who came down from the mountain to search for Bec, deserter, who killed his fellow soldier. Although he is treated as a ruffian or garbage chasing after a deserter among his tribe, he takes pride in his work and considers himself as someone who does necessary work for his tribe.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 43
skills.description: The mechanical golem that the Black Anvil Guild is desperately looking for. It is the most advanced golem design. It animated and ran amok because the artisan accidentally installed a defective component. It partially destroyed the workshop, crushed many Dwarven Artisans who tried to restrain it, and escaped the town. It wanders the woods aimlessly, and attacks any who come nearby.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 59
skills.description: A wild boar that had its soul stolen by an evil mystic's experiment, transforming the beast into a killing machine. It eventually killed the mystic, but this could not give it peace. It searches for a powerful entity that can finally give its soul rest.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: The banished leader of Heltor Silenos. A fanatic follower of Baium, he believes that Baium must be resurrected and will then wipe out all other tribes throughout the continent. Alone in his belief, he and his minions search  the Tower of Insolence for a way to resurrect Baium.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 29
skills.description: The ghost of an Elf who loved all the forest, and vowed to protect nature and her animals from senseless war.  The Elf was eventually slain while performing his duty, and returned as a ghost. He is aided and protected by a herd of wild boar that are loyal to him. He is wary of  strangers who might bring war to the forest.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: A servant of Summoner Sejarr, dispatched from the Ivory Tower to block the Devil Beleth. Sejarr used dark magic to imprison Beleth, but was killed by the devil's reflexive powers. Phantom alone survived of Sejarr's servitors, but was corrupted by the dark magic of Beleth and the Ivory Tower and reconciled with the Wasteland. Although he thinks his owner's death was unjust, he distrust other mystics.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 44
skills.description: A monster plant that has grown by absorbing the poison in the Sea of Spores. It is a follower of Orfen, the Ruler of the Sea of Spores. It was given a task by Orfen to kill trespassing humans. Ivory Tower mystics are sent to tend to the magic force field that prevents spores from spreading, but many have been slain by the Rotting Tree.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 45
skills.description: A Silenos who was a victim of an experiment gone awry, conducted by the Ivory Tower's mystics. Shacram gained supernatural power, but his appearance was so disfigured that he could not return to his tribe. He moved to Oren where he hides in a deserted valley in the south, where rugged mountain paths discourage most  from ever setting foot in the region. He harbors a deep hatred towards the mystics of the Ivory Tower who made him like this.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: A powerful sorcerer who is greatly respected by the Lizardmen. Currently, he is hiding in a distant corner of the plains. He resents how humans continue to encroach upon the Lizardmen's territory, where Lizardmen have lived in peace since ancient times.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 60
skills.description: A shaman of the village, she witnessed Elmore invaders poisoning the well and looked the other way in fear of her life. But when she saw the villagers die one by one, she realized what she had done and lost her mind. She still wanders near the cursed well, and recklessly attacks anyone who comes close, thinking that they are Elmore soldiers.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 74
skills.description: An evil witch of a heretical religion who serves Antharas and sacrifices humans in her rituals. By using Dark Arts on herself, she was able to transform her body into that of a powerful evil spirit. She and her minions will attack any invaders who disrupt Antharas's sleep. Through a lifetime of slaughter, she has transformed into a powerful creature of evil. Now, she enjoys eating human hearts still pumping with warm blood.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 30
skills.description: An evil heathen serving Beleth who came from Devil's Isle. She is trying to spread fear in Gludio, and turn the people towards violence and betrayal. Fear and horror are the source of this devil's power. The recent serial murders, and the rash of theft and arson plaguing Gludio are the work of Meana.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: A life form created by Icarus, who is one of Hardin's disciples. Currently, Icarus has released it to test its behaviors and reactions, and it appears curious and playful, although others find it a nuisance.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: The Executioner who held the Execution Grounds during the Peasant Riot, and executed countless innocent farmers at the command of Duke Ashton. Eventually, he was murdered for his actions. Due to the crimes he committed when alive, he was cursed never to rest in peace, and endlessly wanders in the Execution Grounds.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 50
skills.description: A messenger dispatched to Aden by Fairy Queen Timiniel in order to demand a response to those who have invaded the Enchanted Forest. One of the fearless warriors who guards the Fairy Queen.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 56
skills.description: Gracia's Great Noble who was not able to return to his country after losing in the Aden-Gracia War. During the war, he became lost inside of  Cruma Tower with his troops. While inside the tower he had the opportunity to recruit a few Titans to his cause. When he finally escaped from the tower, the war was already over. The only thing he was left with was a few loyal servants and an enormous bounty on his head. Presently, he is desperately trying to flee to Elmore Kingdom to preserve his life.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 65
skills.description: A gigantic tiger of legend that rules the Anghel Waterfall. Originally, it was a sacred and divine creature who guided angels in the heavens, but it mauled its master and ran away to the earth. It despairs of its now miserable life, and has grown violent. It devours any traveler or reckless adventurers who passes by.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 79
skills.description: As one of Elmoreden's Four Great Kings, the powerful and gigantic Minotaur used to be a servant of Baium.  But to fulfill an old promise, he serves Death Lord Hallate. He waits, locked inside the top floor of the Tower of Insolence, for the resurrection of Baium. Equally matched in warfare with the angel's leader Shuriel, the Fire of Wrath, he holds the line against the advancement of angels and the Platinum tribe.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 24
skills.description: The chieftess of the Langk Lizardmen, she serves the evil spirit Bifrons in exchange for great power. At the command of Bifrons, she captured and slaughtered priests and the Disciples of God traveling on the south road. Recently, she has begun devoting herself to expanding the tribe's power in the north by taking advantage of the chaos in Gludio.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 33
skills.description: The Great Seer who leads the Vuku Orcs. He has more power than Chief Driko, and is held in high esteem as a divine being. He laments that his tribe is forced to wander through the hostile human realm. He hopes to take the tribe back to the northern homeland of the Orcs.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 50
skills.description: The Captain of the Convict Mercenaries from Gracia, he  is called the Lord of Slaughter. He is a powerful rival of the Bloody Lord Nurka. Given his superb diplomatic skills, he has established ties of friendship with many great nobles and high ranking officials. These nobles make frequent use of his troops, the Convicts, and in turn he uses the nobles to set up his plan to return to his homeland, Gracia.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: The Old Chief who has led Leto Lizardmen for the last several decades. In spite of his old age, he has survived thanks to his strength and quick wits. He knows that his tribe cannot take their homeland back in a direct fight against the Kingdom of Aden, so he watches for an opportunity to strike. He hopes to use the coming confusion to secure the territory of the Leto Lizardmen.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: A woman who bargained with the Devil Beleth for power. Thanks to Beleth's teaching, she gained the power of a powerful mystic. Now, she searches for Beleth's historical site supposedly hidden somewhere underground in the south Gludio Wasteland, and prepares a secret ritual to resurrect him.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 65
skills.description: A type of mental control device created by the ancient giants' civilization. This was a device the giants made to rule other intelligent beings, but was turned against them to control the giants as slaves after their civilization collapsed. Similar to Core in the Cruma Tower, it is a life form with artificial intelligence that can control all the slaves nearby.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 78
skills.description: The leader of the vanguard of angels that punished Baium and broke down the Tower of Insolence. He actively works to hold back the devils that smashed through the upper floors of the Tower of Insolence. He guides Kel Mahums of the Platinum Tribe into war against the devils for control of the Tower of Insolence. He is called the Fire of Wrath for he wields the sword of judgment without hesitation, compassion or mercy.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 21
skills.description: An Evil Spirit worshipped like a god by the Langk Lizardmen who live in the south of Gludio. He looks like a snake and has ruled the spiritual world of the lizardmen for hundreds of years. However, he resents the cursed body the gods in the heaven created for him, and he tries to slaughter the messengers of the gods in retribution. He is very violent and burns to destroy the entire area of Gludio one day through the Langk Lizardmen.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 25
skills.description: A knight who used to govern a peaceful town before the Gracian War, today it is called the Ruins of Agony. Called Sir Grindel in his lifetime, he was captured and brutally tortured to death after losing a battle against the Gracian Army. Underlings of Beleth hiding in the town stole his body and resurrected him, making his soul corrupted. Having lost his knightly honor and sense of self-sacrifice, now he has turned into a devil and tries to spread his pain to all he encounters in his endless wanders through the Ruins of Agony.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: A low level devil mistakenly summoned by Shaman King Selu. Due to the forced summoning, he lost the way to return to his original place. Concealing his identity, he attacks travelers passing by and collects their souls in order to gain the power to return.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: Once the ruler of the Selu Orc tribe, he went mad after a dangerous experimental summoning spell he created failed disastrously. Calling himself the Shaman King, he left the tribe's village and, with a group of equally insane followers, preys on hapless travelers. He has some magical skills, but habitually overestimates his ability.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 48
skills.description: A foolish man who could not suppress his powerful yearning to learn the forbidden knowledge that humans cannot attain, and tried to learn the dragons' magic by visiting Land Dragon Antharas alone. Antharas turned the man into a monster for disturbing his rest. Now a hideous creature, the man hates anything beautiful. He curses Antharas in private, but is truly terrified of the dragon.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 54
skills.description: A unicorn aimlessly drifting after losing its home long ago.  It has wandered since the Era of Myths ended with Einhasad's rage against the Titans. The leader of the unicorns lost its herd while roaming the world. Although it is still desperately looking for its fellow unicorns, hundreds of years have passed since it parted ways from them. Wandering alone, it still has not adapted itself to the human world.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 60
skills.description: A failed weapon created by mystics of the Ivory Tower, frightened of the Devil Beleth's eventual resurrection. Although modeled after a Titan, he did not follow his creator's commands, and eventually escaped the tower. He searched for a creature similar to himself for years, investigating relics of the ancient Giants, and concluded that he was the only true Titan that survived the disaster in the past. He dreams of revenge on the gods who made the Titans fall.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: A drake that used to be a guardian of Aden in ancient times, but turned into a devil of revenge after losing his child to a greedy hunter. He has left Dragon Valley to roam the territories near Aden Castle, and killed countless villagers. He also killed the priests who came to calm his rage. All of his good deeds have been erased from the chronicles by Imperial command, and he is now called the Disaster of Aden.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 25
skills.description: A handiwork of darkness created by evil necromancers to contain their desire. It is known that he has a close relationship with the moon. Although many researchers  were dispatched from the Ivory Tower to learn his true purpose, all of them succumbed to Ikuntai's dark power and joined the side of evil. The Ivory Tower has since forbidden any further study of Ikuntai.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 30
skills.description: A bloodthirsty Lord and a veteran warrior known for his great battle victories. According to recent rumors, he is conspiring to overthrow his master.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 38
skills.description: The Convict Mercenary Captain searches for the secrets of the Cruma Tower. After listening to a bard singing a song called Seven Secrets of Cruma Tower, he has decided to officially become a knight of the king by attaining the ancient weapon, which is the third secret of the song. Since Gatekeepers of the Ivory Tower have rejected his teleport as the Convict Tribe is banned from the tower, he still has not entered the tower, but has been circling around it.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 45
skills.description: The brave and great Tiger King. Despite his beastly looks, he rules the Silenos thanks to his divine nature and bravery. Originally, he was one of the Evil Spirits that Shilen created, but he has learned not to hate the gods and endeavored to live up to his position as Tiger King after accumulating wisdom over the years. Among the Silenos Tribe, he is accompanied by loyal shamans.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: A female succubus who is known to have received the special favor of Antharas and obtained the power of the Land Dragon. Although it is not clear how she earned Antharas's favor, she clearly possesses the fatal beauty that can lead adventurers coming to dragon valley to their death.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 60
skills.description: Another subordinate of Glaki. Like Glaki, he also guards the statue of the giants but he does not consider this work a sacred duty. According to legend, the Statue of the Giants can resurrect an incomplete body of a giant to regain a complete body.  It is said that the reason  he is guarding the statue is to earn the trust of Glaki but to fulfill his secret ambition to obtain a perfect and powerful body.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 59
skills.description: A devil and Beleth's servant living on Devil's Isle. After Beleth disappeared from the world, this devil stopped his own activities and has been taking a long vacation. When the pirates occupied Devil's Isle and became raucous, he woke up and regretted that he didn't wipe out the pirates from Devil's Isle before Zaken became immortal. He is waiting for his master, Beleth, to return.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: The Tasaba Lizardman Captain lives in the field of Innadril. At the command of the Water Dragon, Tasaba Lizardmen serving the Water Dragon Fafurion live in the field and keep the Land of Holy Water. He laments that the world is in the era of humans, and misses the past. Every time a full moon comes, he conducts a holy ritual dedicated to the Water Dragon.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 30
skills.description: A beast living in the Innadril Territory as one of the Evil Spirits born from Shilen's pain. He hates Eva who became the Goddess of Water instead of Shilen, and calls her a fake. He still thinks that the true Goddess of water is Shilen.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 34
skills.description: He sneaked into Innadril where Eva's religion was widely practiced, and caused confusion by threatening the Goddess of Water's followers. The servant of Elder Cronos lives in the Hunters' Village.  In order to obtain ingredients for the wonder drug of happiness that Cronos is making, he came to Innadril. After losing himself in daydreams of the world, Mumu forgot why he came here, and hasn't returned to Cronos because he is afraid of being scolded.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 43
skills.description: A Crokian who has protected the land of Innadril since the ancient times. He lived here before humans and elves came to Innadril, and believes that Innadril has holy grounds unique to itself. He has watched the humans endlessly expand over the years, and firmly believes he must protect his ancestors' lands.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: An Evil Spirit born from Goddess Shilen's despair, woe, and rage. Although he fought in the war with the gods on the side of Shilen during the Era of Myths, he was greatly injured in the battle, and has been hiding under the protection of the Water Dragon Fafuion. Lately, he has been rumored to propagate Shilen's return. He serves Fafurion, waiting for the day when Shilen and Evil Spirits dominate the world again.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 36
skills.description: Crokian Chief who rules Alligator Island. As a native Crokian who has lived in Innadril before humans and elves came, he hates outsiders and tries to protect his territory and tribe from them. Although he is not happy about the Water Couatl Ateka living on the same island, he cannot do anything about it because he is afraid of Water Dragon Fafurion. He dreams about the day when Crokians can rule Innadril again.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: As Water Dragon Fafurion's lieutenant, this Evil Spirit defeated countless disciples of the gods. Known as Sika of Storm during the War of the Gods,  he is a veteran warrior and an engaging storyteller. Currently, he travels the world and tells stories at the command of Fafurion.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 50
skills.description: She was a beautiful lady of a respectable family from her birth, but she angered Einhasad by her arrogance and was turned into a Medusa. She could not adjust to her new state and became a brutal monster that takes her anger out on people near her. She even turned her fiancé who remained true to her into stone, and then smashed him to pieces.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 73
skills.description: The leader of the devils trying to occupy the Tower of Insolence. He strives to obtain the secret knowledge hidden in the Tower of Insolence and use it as a bridgehead to expand the power of devils. But he expended too much power trying to break a seal of the Tower, and is now weak. He is enemies with the angels and the Platinum tribe protecting the Tower of Insolence at the command of Einhasad. He has three loyal subordinates: Kernon, Rahha, and Verfa.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: A mercenary hired by a lord during the Dion Peasants' Riot. He was once told that he could achieve eternal life if he collected souls and dedicated them to Shilen, so he slaughtered countless innocent peasants. Disgusted with his brutality, Duke Ashton finally executed him. Even after his death, his desire to gain eternal life was still strong, and he came back to life again as one of the Undead. Presently, he lurks near Dion Castle and kills innocent people.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 62
skills.description: The Oel Mahum Lord who once owned the Bandit Stronghold. Tired of the constant fighting for territory, he abandoned the stronghold along with his loyal seers and prefects, and is observing the competition for the Bandit Stronghold as a spectator.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 75
skills.description: The Storm Dragon Lindvior's underling. During the war against the gods, it fought together with the other dragons against the gods. After receiving a grave injury, it went deep into the woods and fell asleep. It recently awakened after feeling the power of Shilen flowing out from the Tower of Insolence. It is a bit smaller than a regular Drake, but because of its swift movements, it is sometimes mistaken for the Wind Dragon itself.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 57
skills.description: In his youth, he became a hero of the Timak Orcs after leading them to build the Timak Outpost. Granted a greatly extended lifespan by the power of totems, he is now the leader of all Timak Orcs.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 69
skills.description: Through his neglect, this notorious commander helped cause the destruction of his garrison during the war between Elmore and Aden. He unwisely opened the gates to an old Elmorian friend, who abused his trust by poisoning the castle's well. Many of the soldiers and their families died, and Elmore's army easily overran the depleted force. Distraught at his failure, Andras fell on his sword. It is said that his ghost still wanders the castle's ruins.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 60
skills.description: The leader of the Weird Drakes, this ancient creature has slain uncounted numbers of hunters. The bloody history of Hunters Village is largely the result of his ravages.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 72
skills.description: The Vanor Silenos Chief, he rules the Plains of Glory east of Aden. During the Unification in the reign of King Raoul, Kandra agreed to a peace treaty with the humans. As war clouds have gathered, though, he has again taken steps to ready the Vanor Silenos Tribe for battle. Rumor has it that King Raoul proposed the original peace treaty because he feared Kandra's renowned swordsmanship.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 59
skills.description: This dragon guards the southeastern shore of the river in the Forest of Mirrors. Once a ghost in the Forest, he begged the Shaman Isir to restore his life. Resurrected as a dragon, he was ordered by Isir to prevent any outsiders from crossing the river and penetrating the Forest.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: The Harit Lizardmen's best warrior, Tamish is a quiet, reliable perfectionist who never gives up on his task until it has been completed. Entrusted with guarding Anghel Waterfall, he has admirably protected the Harit Lizardmen's Holy Land against all manner of monsters and devils.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 75
skills.description: Discovered in the Giants' Cave, some scholars speculate that given his combat prowess, this Lesser Titan is actually a real Titan. Hedging their bets, they named him the Last Lesser Giant Olkuth.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 78
skills.description: He protects the Divine Statue of Giants, an ancient relic of the Giants located deep inside the Giants' Cave. No one knows what the statue means or why it is so fiercely guarded.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 72
skills.description: Once the commander of the infamous Death Agent Army that ravaged the land, terrorizing friends and foes alike, he was eventually demoted at the request of several prominent nobles. He was later killed in battle when his army was sacrificed as bait. Not even death could end his bloodlust, however. Calling upon the magic of Darkness, he and his army were resurrected as undead soldiers. Now the Commander of the Undead, he  roams old battlefields and threatens the Border Outpost with a gleaming, rust-proof blade.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 75
skills.description: This plant-shaped monster is found near the Blazing Swamp. According to one theory, Palatanos is the result of a failed experiment. After Ipos arose from purgatory, his influence and magic were not the equal of Hallate, and he was unable to create the same kind of powerful underlings. Too proud to ask Hallate for help, however, he tried honing his skills on relatively simple monsters. Despite Palatanos' strange origin and appearance, he can still be a potentially dangerous adversary.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: The Queen of the Falibati protects the Seal of Shilen. According to Shilen's Priest Hisilrome, who is also a Falibati, Themis is a living piece of the Queen of Evil Spirits, Shilen. Themis is one of the monsters birthed by Shilen during the War of the Gods, and as a result her authority nearly equals that of the Death Lords. Capable of summoning and ruling over both dead and devils, she employs the low-level devil, Succubus, as her maid.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 65
skills.description: The leader of the Ancient Gargoyles, he led them in the service of Shilen against the gods during the War of the Gods. After their defeat, he fled to the Forsaken Plains. There he hides, sharpening his blade of vengeance and waiting for Shilen, Mother of Evil Spirits, to return.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 60
skills.description: This High Prefect of the Taik Orcs occupied the Cemetery in preparation for an attack on Aden Castle. He has attempted an unsuccessful surprise attack using only a small number of elite soldiers and the supply troops, but has been hampered by having to deal with the complicated interests of other monsters who had already built a nest in the region. His hatred of humans is deep, personal and deadly.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: This executioner once served the great Pirate Zaken, even putting to death Zaken's rebellious crew members. Ironically, he later decapitated Zaken himself during the riot. Following his resurrection as an undead because of Zaken's curse, he swore to never again disobey his captain's commands. He now guards Zaken's treasure in the Pirate Tunnel.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 45
skills.description: This Iron Giant was supposedly made by Devil Beleth. Given the power of artificial intelligence, he is a Golem designed to manage other Golems. Due to Beleth's caprice, however, he was sealed up and put on standby. During his inactivity, he began to be worshipped as an idol by low-level Orcs who gathered near him. Now re-activated, he believes that he has become the God of Orcs.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 67
skills.description: Like most monsters in the Blazing Swamp, Sekina also became a devil after receiving the power of Hallate. She is loyal to Kernon, who is currently in the Tower of Insolence, and is currently carrying out a secret mission on his orders in the Blazing Swamp area. The exact nature of the mission is unknown.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 75
skills.description: Despite being a daughter of a noble family in Elmore Kingdom, she was one of the girls buried alive after being captured during the war. As she lay dying, her terror allowed her to summon a devil. She entered into a demonic contract which gave her the power to resurrect the other buried girls as Blood Queens. She hates her parents for allowing her capture as well as those who buried her.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: During the golden years of Elmoreden, this King of Beasts was captured and brought to the Coliseum as a spectacle to entertain the Emperor and his court. When the empire fell, he was sealed beneath the Coliseum by mystics afraid of his vengeance, but late escaped. His gigantic arms can shatter rocks, and he is able to rule all beasts.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 28
skills.description: The commander of the Ol Mahum tribes that occupy the old Fortress of Resistance, he also he commands other Ol Mahums within the territory through his superior cleverness and bravery. He is a descendant of the Ol Mahum Commander created through biological manipulation during the Era of Titans, and like his ancestor can directly command the minds of other Ol Mahums.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 50
skills.description: This menacing golem was created by the Titans to defend Cruma Tower during their war with the Gods. It waits patiently in the Tower's lowest level for orders from its Titan masters - orders that will never come.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 75
skills.description: This powerful Death Lord rose up from Purgatory at the behest of Death Lord Hallate. Unlike Hallate, who exhausted most of his power breaking the seal of the Tower of Insolence, Ipos has preserved most of his. He prefers conspiracies and subtle plots to direct action and is currently keenly interested in the situation near Aden Castle. He seems to have some kind of relationship with several high-ranking nobles in Aden Kingdom.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 50
skills.description: This Queen of the Elves first decided to teach humans magic. Later betrayed by those humans, she was murdered following the war with the Orcs. Resurrected by Lilith, she became the ruler of the Catacomb. She was slain during Anakim's invasion of the Catacomb, but again came back to life - this time thanks to the power of Seal Stone. The repeated trauma has made her mentally unstable, and her sole purpose now is the protection of the Seal Stone. She longs for eternal rest.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: This brave Convict Soldier was dispatched by Einhasad to help her daughter, Anakim, after watching her struggle at the battle with Lilim. He was given powerful golden armor and may be the ancestor of today's Platinum Tribe. He valiantly protected Anakim during many battles before finally being slain in the Catacomb of the Apostate. When the Seal of the Seven Signs was broken, he was resurrected thanks to the power of Einhasad released in the Seal Stone.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: The King of Bloody Lords, he was summoned by Marilion to help fend off an impending Nephilim attack. Terrifying in battle, he slew many Nephilim and dealt a grievous blow to the Army of Light. He was finally driven back by Anakim, who personally came to fight alongside the Nephilim, and fled to the Necropolis.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 75
skills.description: A powerful death lord who came up from Purgatory at the request of Death Lord Hallant. Unlike Hallant, who exhausted its power in order to break the seal on the Tower of Insolence, it has kept most of its power from Purgatory. Unlike Death Lord Ipos, it doesn't make relationships with humans, and it acts alone without heeding the words of Hallant.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: Known as the Holy Mother of Darkness, Lilith rules Necropolis and awaits Shilen's resurrection. She began serving Shilen as the First Titan's oracle, when Shilen was still the Goddess of Water. After Shilen's fall, she was left behind and ordered to prepare for the goddess's resurrection. Armed with a new, powerful body, Lilith has secretly instigated many conflicts between humans and Elves. She resurrects those who died in battle to serve as her undead army. Completely loyal to Shilen, she will do anything to hasten her return.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This Angel appeared to Emperor Shunaiman during the Crisis of Shilen's Children. Called the Sacred Flame or Einhasad's Messenger, she led the Forces of Light in an attack on Necropolis to dislodge Lilim and Lilith. Accidentally sealed in with Lilith, she remains her eternal enemy. Despite her power, she looks like a beautiful and innocent young girl.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 20
skills.description: This immortal creature was created by Dark Elven dark magic. During the early days of the war between the Elves and Dark Elves, the Dark Elves found themselves on the defensive. Experimenting with the power of Dark Arts they had embraced, they resurrected a number of slain warriors. Once a brave elven knight, Ferkel became of those revived warriors turned into bloodthirsty undead beasts. He slaughtered countless fellow Elves during the war and even now thirsts for the blood of living beings.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 78
skills.description: Created by the dark side of the God of Light, Einhasad, to punish the arrogance of the Giant Argos, this giant Monster Eye is set in the Wall of Argos. It controls other monster eyes in order to eradicate the eyes of Argos and thwart his plans.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 78
skills.description: This servant of the Fairy Queen was dispatched to protect the hot springs, a resort that Fairy Queen Timiniel loves. With power almost equal to the Queen's, he is a little disgruntled at what he feels is so menial an assignment. To pass the time and ease his boredom, he often "plays" with travelers passing by. Unfortunately for them, his hijinks are more than most humans can endure.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 74
skills.description: The leader of the Mineral Spring Yetis in the hot springs area, he styles himself the Icicle Emperor. Despite his arrogant posturing, he is at heart a coward. He once marched into Fire Dragon Valakas' nest to prove his strength, but became frightened and fled at the mere site of Valakas' sleeping form. He is now terrified of Valakas, and runs away or hides at even the sound of roaring.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This Orc soldier is the right arm of Commander Tayr and greatly respected by the Ketra Orc Warriors. With his immense axe, nicknamed Divider, he slew so many Silenos that their compatriots are more afraid of him than they are of Commander Tayr.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This merciless and reckless warrior has led the Ketra Orcs for many years. A born gambler, he prefers direct action to elaborate plans, and personally leads his troops from the front line during an attack. He has faced Varka's Commander Mos twice, winning one of the contests, and is eager for a rematch.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: Brakki obtained the power of Soul of Fire Nastron, which gave him beast-like attributes. Thanks to his enhanced strength and instincts, he has become a formidable chief of the Ketra Orcs. He finds his inferiors burdensome during a battle, however, and prefers to fight alone. He has fought Varka's Chief Horus several times without success.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: Soul of Fire summoned by Ketra Orcs' Soul Guide Asefa. Possessed with a strong propensity to wildness and violence, he tends to burn or destroy anything near him. He gave Ketra's Chief Brakki the power of the beasts, and is the power source of spells used by Asefa.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This great sage is sometimes called Varka Silenos' Hope. He prophesied that the future of Varka Silenos was in the land of Goddard and persuaded Chief Horus to lead Silenos there. Despite age and infirmity, he stood in the front ranks to aid Commander Mos against the powerful Ketra Orcs.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This legendary Varka Silenos commander has helped lead his people in the endless war against the Ketra Orcs. A resourceful general, he prefers painstaking preparations and cunning, often elaborate, plans. He has had difficulty anticipating Commander Tayr's reckless tactics.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This young chief of the powerful mercenary Varka Silenos is an excellent swordsman. He is ably assisted by his commander, Mos, and his shaman, Shadith.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This Soul of Water was summoned by Soul Guide Udan Mardui of the Varka Silenos. He is capricious but peaceful, and provides the power source for the Soul Guide.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: Known as Valakas' Hound, Valakas fashioned this monster out of lava to punish trespassers and fend off enemies while he sleeps.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 66
skills.description: Once an excellent knight, this Elmorean nobleman sold his soul to Devil Triol in exchange for eternal life and power. Transformed into a vampire, he was dispatched by Devil Triol's followers to steal Einhasad's relic, the Grail of Splendor.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: This Archangel keeps the Grail of Splendor, a relic of Einhasad, Goddess of Light. She does not reveal her existence openly, but is closely watching the actions of devils within Elmore Kingdom.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 71
skills.description: The oldest son of the notorious von Hellmann Family that was executed for treason. Through a diabolical contract, he was resurrected as a vampire. He now wanders the Forest of the Dead, dreaming about his revenge.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 28
skills.description: A being that tries to invade the real world by crossing the Dimensional Rift along with the otherworldly devils. Its shape is very unstable because of the Rift's distortion of time and space.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 38
skills.description: A being that tries to invade the real world by crossing the Dimensional Rift along with the otherworldly devils. Due to the influence of the rift where time and space are distorted, it has a very unstable shape.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 48
skills.description: A being that tries to invade the real world by crossing the Dimensional Rift along with the otherworldly devils. Due to the influence of the rift where time and space are distorted, it has a very unstable shape.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 58
skills.description: A being that tries to invade the real world by crossing the Dimensional Rift along with the otherworldly devils. Due to the influence of the rift where time and space are distorted, it has a very unstable shape.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 68
skills.description: A being that tries to invade the real world by crossing the Dimensional Rift along with the otherworldly devils. Due to the influence of the rift where time and space are distorted, it has a very unstable shape.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 78
skills.description: A being that tries to invade the real world by crossing the Dimensional Rift along with the otherworldly devils. Due to the influence of the rift where time and space are distorted, it has a very unstable shape.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: One of four Guardian Knights assigned to protect Prince Frintezza, he was sacrificed and sold to Halisha by the unwise Prince in an attempt to save his own skin. In his lifetime, he was called Valkyrie Alectia of Flames because of his beautiful appearance, excellent skills and fiery temper.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: One of four Guardian Knights assigned to protect Prince Frintezza, he was sacrificed and sold to Halisha by the unwise Prince in an attempt to save his own skin. In his lifetime, he was called Valkyrie Tishas of Calmness because of his handsome appearance, formidable skill and dignified character.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: One of four Guardian Knights assigned to protect Prince Frintezza, he was sacrificed and sold to Halisha by the unwise Prince in an attempt to save his own skin. In his lifetime, he was called Valkyrie Meka Snowstorm due to his excellent skills and ice-cold personality.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: One of four Guardian Knights assigned to protect Prince Frintezza, he was sacrificed and sold to Halisha by the unwise Prince in an attempt to save his own skin. In his lifetime, he was called Valkyrie Morigul of the Ivory Tower because he hailed from the Ivory Tower.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 30
skills.description: This Basilisk obtained intelligence after the dark magic polluting the Wasteland mutated him. Bigger and stronger than other Basilisks, he rules over weaker ones. He hates the other tribes and will literally kill most living things he sees.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: This Gargoyle Lord rules the Gargoyles of the Wasteland. Strong-willed and confident, he resists the wishes of the Ancient Gargoyles. Rather than waiting for Shilen's resurrection, which he says may never occur, he is focused on building a Gargoyle kingdom now.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 21
skills.description: This Ratman Chief lives in Gludio Mountain and uses mercenary Bugbear Soldiers to plunder travelers passing through Gludio Castle. To stop the attacks, the lord of Gludio has offered a reward on his head. Despite Gludio's efforts, Sukar continues to harass wayfarers.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 26
skills.description: This powerful Hornet, who can be recognized by his tiger stripe pattern, controls a nest of several wasps. Searching for the sweetest honey, he and his subordinates maraud their way through Gludio Territory.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 23
skills.description: This Lizardman Warrior became famous after destroying the mercenary army sent to destroy his tribe. He is known as the Tracker Leader, since his preferred tactic is to stealthily track his enemies and attack when they least expect it.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 26
skills.description: This Patriarch appeared suddenly, prophesying that he would become the Great Lizardman Conqueror. His powerful personal presence is gradually undermining the prevailing worship of Serpent Demon Bifrons. His promise that anyone can become a conqueror through him has gained him a large and growing group of followers.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 23
skills.description: This fanatical Priest serves Patriarch Kuroboros and is helping spread the new conquering religion among the Lizardmen in southern Gludio. He devoutly believes that the Patriarch will make Lizardmen glorious conquerors someday, and his small number of worshipers and disciples are fervently spreading the words of Kuroboros.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 25
skills.description: These Ghosts wander the Ruins of Agony, taking the souls of careless adventurers. Originally residents slain during the war, their spirits were called forth and controlled by the powerful dark magic of Beleth's followers.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 20
skills.description: Created to protect a huge building in what is now the Elven Ruins, he was discarded without having the opportunity to display his ability when the Elves suddenly abandoned the island. Now this Guardian wanders the ruins, punishing trespassing adventurers and foolish grave robbers.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 21
skills.description: This Devil, a subordinate of Devil Dagoniel, was summoned by the Dark Elves during their war with the Elves. He slew many Elven Warriors during his forced service. When Devil Dagoniel was liberated from the summoning Dark Elves, he was liberated as well. He currently serves as Dagoniel's aide.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 20
skills.description: Created by mystics at the Institute of Dark Arts who were researching monsters skilled in mental attack, this monster can inflict powerful mental blasts. Thanks to its superior intelligence, it also controls other beasts.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 21
skills.description: This Succubus is Lich King Icarus' disciple and messenger, having served the Lich King since Icarus controlled Hardin's Academy. A loyal slave, she has learned various Dark Arts, including the control of bats, from her master.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 34
skills.description: This Knight was executed after siding with the peasants during the Dion Peasant Riot against the brutal Duke Ashton. He slew Guillotine after the latter killed the captured peasant rebels and their families, and for that was brutally executed. He became a ghost because of his undying rage over Ashton's injustice.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 36
skills.description: This Devil sustains himself from the storm of hatred and grudges that abound in the ghosts who roam the Execution Grounds. Standing at the center of the Execution Grounds, he controls the ghosts. There is a rumor that Ashton's brutal temperament stemmed in part from this Evil Spirit Tempest.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: Captain of the powerful convict mercenary band called the Red Eye. He was drafted with other convicts during Gracia's invasion, but was abandoned by the main army during a retreat. Following the war, he and his men did not return to their country, preferring to stay in the  Dion Territory occupied during the war, sacking and ambushing. He believes the Gracian Army and its commanders were cowards for leaving his men behind.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 33
skills.description: Messenger sent by Bloody Lord Nurka to communicate with the high-ranking officials of the kingdom. He is a brave Ol Mahum Warrior on his way to Aden on a top secret mission.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 32
skills.description: Royal Guard Captain of Stakato Queen Zyrnna, he is the strongest soldier among the Marsh Stakatos and commands a Royal Guard consisting only of Stakato nobles. He is as cruel as Zyrnna, and has murdered many of his people at his Queen's command.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 38
skills.description: This unidentified two-headed monster calls himself the first-ranking person, Premo Prime. Some say he was a product of some Giants' experiment, but no one knows exactly where he came from - including himself. Each head seems to have its own distinct personality. One calls itself Premo, the other Prime. Despite his lofty-sounding name, he is not very intelligent.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 45
skills.description: This artificial intelligence management system was designed by the Giants to defend the Cruma Tower. It controls multiple upper-class Susceptors against attackers.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 35
skills.description: One of the Monster Eyes who acted as a spy for Devil Beleth during his failed rebellion. Now that Beleth is sealed away, the Eye is responsible for providing Beleth's followers with information.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 32
skills.description: Leader of Zenta Lizardmen who serve Antharas. He argues that Zenta Lizardmen are the predecessors of the Land Dragon. Aggressive and hostile, he attacks anyone he perceives is the enemy of Antharas.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 33
skills.description: This pirate once ruled the South Sea of Giran along with Pirate King Zaken. Calling himself Zaken's only rival, he raided the Pirate King's headquarters after hearing the news that Zaken was missing. Instead of treasure, he and his mean were struck down by Zaken's curse. Now an undead, his sole aim is to take his revenge on Zaken someday.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 60
skills.description: This foolish noble led the Land Dragon Punitive Force against Antharas during the age of the Elmoreden Kingdom. His incompetence caused the slaughter of the entire force, and he was sacrificed to the claw of the Land Dragon. As a cruel joke, Antharas resurrected Ishka, and put him in charge of protecting the Dragon Valley.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: Leader of the Road Scavengers who occupy Death Pass and threaten Giran Territory. Cowardly by nature, the Road Scavengers mainly attack the elderly or unarmed travelers.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 47
skills.description: This Immortal Warrior was sent by Emperor Elmoreden to protect the Seal of Antharas. Straying from the supervision of Watchman, he was transformed by the area's dark magic into a cruel monster and now attacks anyone who approaches the Dragon Valley.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: This cranky, ambitious Wyrm leads the Wyrms in the Gorgon Flower Garden against the occupying Gorgons. He is forcing even neutral Wyrms into conflict with the Gorgons. He hates Gorgon Queen Stenoa passionately.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 44
skills.description: This Immortal Knight is searching for Orfen in the Sea of Spores. As a young adventurer, he and his lover joined the Sea of Spores Troops. Orfen's plot caused her death, however, and Kraven's sorrow and rage helped him gain an immortal body in order to revenge himself on Orfen with his sharp, fearsome blade.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 48
skills.description: This Riba follows Arachne Orfen. Unlike other monsters living in the Sea of Spores, he possesses great intelligence and profound magical knowledge. At Orfen's command, he is searching for flaws in the Ivory Tower's magic force field, which blocks the spores from advancing.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 61
skills.description: This capricious Queen of All the Fairies has ruled the Enchanted Forest for thousands of years. She fears the gradual weakening of the Seal of Shilen .

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 25
skills.description: This Maraku Werewolf Chief was once the ally of the Urutu Orcs and peacefully coexisted with them. Then he suddenly attacked the Urutu Tribe while its power was weakened, inflicting a serious blow. He and his Werewolves are now in engaged in an all-out attempt to conquer the Immortal Plateau, ancestral home to Orcs.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: This Ol Mahum Warrior is warring with other bandit leaders for Oren's Bandit Stronghold. Although he cannot personally perform spells, he still has profound knowledge about magic and numbers several Shamans among his subordinates. For an Ol Mahum, he is somewhat prudent and cautious.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 45
skills.description: This savage hero leads the Timak Orc Warriors in battle. Unlike Chertuba and Ragoth, fighting is his only expertise and interest. Surprisingly, that makes him popular among many Orcs who do not comprehend Chertuba's idealism or Ragoth's wisdom.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 44
skills.description: This legendary Ratman Bandit became famous for invading the Guild of Hunters Village and stealing the Guild's symbol, the Legendary Bow. Unlike other Ratman Bandits, he has outsmarted many hunters of Hunters Village through his bold and elaborate plans.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 45
skills.description: This Evil Spirit inherited the blood of some of the most powerful dragons numbered among Shilen's children. When the War of Gods concluded, he crawled underground and went into hibernation. He awoke during the Time of Chaos and has since ruled the entire Hunters Valley with terror. He is one of the biggest challenges for the Hunters Guild.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 65
skills.description: Once the General Construction Manager in charge of building the Tower of Insolence at command of Emperor Baium, he was executed by the enraged Emperor after numerous construction delays. His lingering spirit became a powerful ghost when the Energy of Life poured out of the Tower when it collapsed. He still wanders near the Tower of Insolence, waiting to take his revenge on the imprisoned Emperor.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 71
skills.description: This mystic assisted Emperor Baium construct the Tower of Insolence to obtain the secret of eternal life. Evoking the wrath of Einhasad, he was slain by Angels but returned to life thanks to the secret knowledge he already possessed. Now he is working to free Baium.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 79
skills.description: The leader of the Angels who guard the Tower of Insolence and Baium, including Fire of Wrath Shuriel. He is directly descended from Einhasad.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: This giant Wyvern lives in the Blazing Swamp and controls all Wyverns and River Wyrms in the area. He feels the entire Blazing Swamp is Wyvern territory and is very displeased about the activities of the devils who have invaded the Swamp.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 49
skills.description: Hidden deep inside the Forest of Mirrors, this Devil's Mirror supposedly steals the soul of whoever looks into it. It was created by the Lords of Hell to collect souls as a sacrifice to Gran Kain.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 51
skills.description: A famous knight from Oren who served in the war to eradicate the monsters in the Forest of Mirrors. But his troops were defeated and he was eventually overcome by Oblivion's Mirror. Now he wanders the woods with no memory of the past, a dead man with a lost soul.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 56
skills.description: The son of Fierce Tiger King Angel, called the Guardian of Harit Lizardmen, he was sent by his father to help the Harit Lizardmen who had protected Anghel Waterfall for generations.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 64
skills.description: Created by Giants who fled Einhasad's rage, this living organism was evolved from the Monster Eye. After the punishment of the Gods ended, Gorgolos turned its vicious teeth on its creators.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 66
skills.description: The last Giant hiding deep inside the Giants Cave. Although his body no better than other Lesser Giants, he possesses the secrets of the Ancient Giants' civilization.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 52
skills.description: This Orc Warrior invaded the Cemetery as part of High Prefect Arak's plan to capture Aden Castle. Frustrated by the constant fighting with the monsters of the Cemetery, he and his men began to run short on supplies. His successful solution earned him the nickname Grave Robber Kim.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: This distinguished knight died in battle during the war with Elmore Kingdom long ago. He was denied eternal rest, however, when monsters and devils invaded the Cemetery during the Troubles and awakened his spirit. He now attacks not only the devils who disturbed him, but also any living creature entering the Cemetery.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 65
skills.description: This Falibati Priest serves Queen Themis and worships the Goddess Shilen. He regards the Queen as one of Shilen's fragments that descended to earth and eagerly awaits the day when the Seal of Shilen is completely broken. He continuously performs rituals sacrificing the blood of the pure and innocent to Shilen.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 53
skills.description: Originally a follower of Beleth under the leadership of Devil Kurikups, this Dark Mage was cursed by the Pirate King Zaken, who believed Kenishee lied to him that the Cruma Tower had secrets of immortality hidden inside. Instead of dying, he became a ghost - some say because of the Dark Arts he had studied so well.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 50
skills.description: Thi subordinate of Pirate King Zaken instigated the crew to mutiny after Zaken told him the location of his fabled treasure. When Zaken returned as an immortal undead, Tilion was the first he killed - rather gruesomely. He was later resurrected and entrusted with slaying anyone setting foot on Devil's Isle.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: The Spirit of Water, he was born with Innadril's strong water spirits and loved by Goddess Eva. Reckless and petty, he enjoys evil tricks such as switching infants and causing floods in the middle of the night. To protect him from anyone seeking revenge, Eva gave him Guardian Spirits.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 40
skills.description: One of the Evil Spirits born by Goddess Shilen, it was hideously scarred during the War of the Gods. It fled to earth and has been hiding for thousands of years. It is served by the tribe of Tasaba Lizardmen while it waits for the day when Shilen returns.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 55
skills.description: This spirit manages the Garden of Eva, keeping it ever ready for the Goddess when she comes to rest.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 52
skills.description: This messenger of the Water Dragon Fafurion was sent to the Goddess Eva to complain about his situation. After she ceased visiting the Garden of Eva, he remained behind to guide invading Stakatos.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 45
skills.description: This Crokian Shaman serves the Water Dragon Fafurion. He assists Chief Sebek and delivers Fafurion's commands to the Crokian Tribe. With his magic he can control the alligators of Alligator Island.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: One of the 4 guardian dogs that protect the room where the Fire Dragon Valakas sleeps, these Gatekeepers of Hell have been weaned on the blood of Valakas to make them stronger.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 82
skills.description: One of the 4 guardian dogs that protect the room where the Fire Dragon Valakas sleeps, these Gatekeepers of Hell have been weaned on the blood of Valakas to make them stronger.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 83
skills.description: One of the 4 guardian dogs that protect the room where the Fire Dragon Valakas sleeps, these Gatekeepers of Hell have been weaned on the blood of Valakas to make them stronger.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 84
skills.description: One of the 4 guardian dogs that protect the room where the Fire Dragon Valakas sleeps, these Gatekeepers of Hell have been weaned on the blood of Valakas to make them stronger.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 85
skills.description: A guardian of Flame Pass which is a passage connected to Valakas' nest. He is a life form created by Valakas with lava to resemble him in order to remove any intruder who interferes with the Fire Dragon's sleep or tries to harm the dragon.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 25
skills.description: When customers fail to pay Merchants of Mammon, Talos is summoned to collect. A low-level devil that used to live in Hell, Talos has entered into a contract with the ancient Merchants of Mammon and helped them ever since. Only the elders of the Dwarf Guilds know of the contract's existence.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 44
skills.description: Created by the ancient mystics of the Ivory Tower while they were investigating the Secrets of Infinite Flame contained in the flame stone, the Golem seemed to be a failed experiment and was discarded. Reawakened recently, it now wanders near the Ivory Tower and interferes with Spirits of Flame. Not surprisingly, it has become a major headache for the mystics.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 70
skills.description: A messenger of Fafurion. This drake, Loch Ness, whose ancestor is the Water Dragon Fafurion, delivers messages from Fafurion to Lizardmen and Crokians.  Since Fafurion is barely interested in these two insignificant tribes, Loch Ness handles them at its discretion. It despises creatures weaker than it is.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 72
skills.description: The Great Seer of Virud Lizardmen. He is an ardent follower of Fafurion. Being a powerful shaman, he believes that the Water Dragon Fafurion will lead the Lizardmen to a great day of glory. He does not know that Fafurion barely notices his people.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 74
skills.description: The Emperor of Crokians, who calls himself Padisha,  lives on Alligator Island. He has a cadre of elite bodyguards who obey his commands, however many Crokians following the Water Dragon instead of him. While this makes him angry, he does not dare challenge Fafurion.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 76
skills.description: Einhasad's Messenger who came down to observe the behaviors of the Water Dragon Fafurion. He hates the dragon who killed so many of his allies during the Heaven War, but the gods prohibit him from fighting Fafurion.
