skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 30
skills.description: His exploits are famous among Wererats. After assigning the South to the Sukar Wererats, he and a group of followers journeyed north in search of wealth. Unlike other Wererats, he possesses an enterprising spirit and began plundering the tombs of Orc tribal chiefs. Chased away by vengeful spirits, now he and his band rob unwary travelers passing through the region.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 39
skills.description: Once a human magician with an almost Dwarven interest in machinery, he heard about Titan Age Sky Wagon Relic and theorized that a combination of Dwarven skills and magic could reproduce the flying wagon. He died without succeeding in his goal, but his spirit still wanders the area.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 37
skills.description: This villain preys on adventurers who travel between the Dwarven Village and the Town of Schuttgart. He summoned all the northern Goblin powers to create a great bandit force and rule over them, but he made a serious mistake by stealing tribute intended for Schuttgart. Hearing rumors that the lord was preparing an army to clear out the bandits, he and his followers fled to the mountains.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 53
skills.description: Originally worshiped Pa'agrio, but he is a shaman who tries to rule Orcs and Elmoaden by using the evil power of  Kasha. They are extending their territory by using evil spirits, insects and Ragna Orcs who follow them.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 52
skills.description: This powerful Chaos Golem was made from Starstones gathered from the Ruins of Pavel by the mad scientist Dr. Chaos, who styles himself the Emperor of Evil. Once a Golem Maestro, Dr. Chaos was expelled from the Black Anvil Guild for trying to steal the blueprint from the elders. He swore revenge on the Black Anvil Guild, conquering the Ruins of Pavel with the Horrifying Golem Army he created. He views all outsiders as assassins sent by the Guild and will attack immediately. His ultimate goal is “world domination.”

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 59
skills.description: This captain secretly loved the Princess Felicia. Saddened by her disappearance, he set out to learn her fate. Finding her transformed into the Ice Queen, Freya, he was turned into a Gargoyle and now protects the Frozen Labyrinth from interlopers.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This Queen of Spike Stakatos conducts breeding experiments using top-ranking Spike Stakatos. She knows that her life running out and is desperately trying to grow a new Stakato queen in her nest, despite the low chances for success. Nursing her power, she dreams of a resurgence of her weakened race.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: Although he appears human, he is actually a high-ranking Angel who directly interacts with Einhasad and worships the Grail. Recently an ancient religious document found in the Tower of Insolence provided proof that the Grail is hidden in the Monastery of Silence. Since then, adherents of the Pagan Temple have frequently tried to steal it, but none has avoided the judgment of the Lord of Splendor.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This aristocrat of Rune secretly worships Triol, even conducting the occasional bloody worship ceremony in the Temple. Despite her claims of nobility, much of her background is still unknown.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 73
skills.description: This Golem was originally a follower of Argos during the war between Giants and Humans. He remained with his master after Argos's imprisonment by Einhasad into the cliff wall. He has devolved to the point that he no longer resembles a Titan and isn't sure why he is still there. Even Daimon the White-Eyed cannot harm him in the Wall of Argos.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 76
skills.description: Artificial creature made from Hardin's magic experiment. Although it has the body of a monster erupting lava all over, it used to be an obedient golem that followed Hardin like a father. It went crazy after Hardin left this Swamp of Flames with the thought that it was deserted. When King Astaire invaded Aden Kingdom, some Elmore soldiers trapped in the Swamp of Flames witnessed a giant covered with lava.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 60
skills.description: The Ice Fairy who came to Freya after Princess Felicia was turned, she oversees everything in the Frozen Labyrinth on behalf of Freya. She has watched the movements of the Zinnia Guild ever since the Order of Canna Knights disappeared.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: An evil undead version of the elder of twin knights who were famous warriors in Gracia before the fall. When both appear at the same time, their powers are enhanced.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: An evil undead version of the younger of twin knights who were famous warriors in Gracia before the fall. When both appear at the same time, their powers are enhanced.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: An undead version of a famous healer in Gracia before the fall. It served Ekimus and later aspired to rule the Hall of Erosion.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: An undead version of an infamous serial killer infamous throughout Gracia before the fall. He attempted to preserve his life by threatening Cohemenes, but was deceived and became an undead slave.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: Steals souls in order to secrete matter from the Seed of Infinity. These Soul Devourers eventually lose all capacity for thought, driven only by their unholy appetite. Thy particularly favor souls that suffered a horrific and agonizing death.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: An undead version of the royal astrologer in Gracia before the fall. While alive, his intentionally false prophecy opened the kingdom to the influence of Ekimus and the Seed of Infinity.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: An undead version of a former Gracian high priest. Obsessed with attaining eternal life, he played a pivotal role in bringing the Seed of Infinity to the capital. He styled himself the 1st priest of Ekimus.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: An exceptionally efficient pre-fall Gracian provincial official infamous for his brutal interrogation methods. He was transformed into undead by the Seed of Infinity.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: In his bid for power, he committed atrocities in Gracia rarely seen before the fall. Because of his thirst for violence and bloodshed, he was transformed into undead by the Seed of Infinity..

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: This undead monster was once a powerful warlord on the frontier of pre-fall Gracia. He believed that the enemy's power was contained in their blood, and so he killed countless prisoners in order to absorb their strength. He was transformed into undead by the Seed of Infinity.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: This undead monster was once  of the most powerful warlords in Gracia. He gained popularity among the fallen nobles for mercilessly carrying out his missions, whatever the cost. He was also a secret worshipper of the Goddess of Death.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: This undead monster was created from the rage and pain of prisoners tortured and killed in ancient Gracia.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: This undead monster was created to protect a sacred burial ground for nobles in ancient Gracia.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: This undead monster was created to prevent the corpses left on the battlefields of ancient Gracia from being raised.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: This undead monster fed on the souls of ancient Gracians. It awoke from its long slumber though the magic of Ekimus.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 81
skills.description: This ancient undead monster awoke through the magic power of the Seed of Infinity. Once it was a powerful Gracian warrior, but now it lacks any vestige of its former self.

skills.description: Lord of ancient Hwuh whose hand was imbued with Demon power in return for not taking action while Hwuh was being conquered by the Seed of Infinity. He now has the power to control Aurabirds and has become a Master Rider.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This ill-tempered king of the birds in Gracia has become even more violent after losing its sky nest to the Storm Dragon Lindvior.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: One of the ladies-in-waiting of the Banshee Queen, she became close to Ekimus and eventually was transformed into a Banshee Queen herself.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 80
skills.description: This Drake originally appeared with the Seed of Destruction. Though one of the children of Skellus, the Dragon of Darkness , it does not serve Tiat. Instead, it watches Tiat's actions for Skellus.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 83
skills.description: One of the monsters born of the Goddess Shilen. When the Great Sprite Gildor is weakened, it leads the Tasaba Lizardmen into the Reed Field, but when the Tasaba Lizardmen are wiped out by the appearance of the Mucrokians, it spews tremendous anger.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 84
skills.description: Water sprite born from the powerful waters of Innadril. It is greatly beloved by the Goddess Eva. It's a trickster that does whatever it wants, like snatching babies or causing floods in the middle of the night. Eva fears retaliation one day because of Lian's severe tricks, and she puts him in the care of guardian spirits.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 82
skills.description: Because of the item that was made in the image of the giants by the Ivory Tower magicians, it believes it is a giant itself. It is controlled by Hekaton Prime, and it guards the cave that was once the fortress of the giants.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 82
skills.description: Lifeform created by the giants that were fleeing by night the wrath of Einhasad. It was improved with a Monster Eye as its foundation and it was created to exterminate the pursuers of the gods.  At one time, it broke free from the control of the giants and fought against them. Its mind is now controlled by Hekaton prime, and it again protects the giants.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 83
skills.description: Last Lesser Giant hiding deep inside the Giant's Cave. Though it is physically the same as the other Lesser Giants, it contains the secret of the ancient lesser giant civilization, and it protects this secret. It is currently controlled by Hekaton Prime.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 83
skills.description: Control device created by the ancient giants civilization. It has outgrown its original research goal. It's only goal now is to protect the cave. It is transforming it into a powerful protected fortress by controlling the minds of the other races and by maintaining the Giant's Cave.

skills.name: 84 level Raid Boss
skills.description: It was one of the dragons that was born out of the blood that was thrown up by Antharas. After swallowing the Ancient Drake and absorbing its power, it quickly arose as a Commander that rules over the monsters nearby. It has good hearing but its vision is very poor, so it waits in a quiet, dark place, listening to the enemy's heartbeat, before swooping in for an attack.

skills.name: 84 level Raid Boss
skills.description: It was one of the dragons that was born out of the blood that was thrown up by Antharas. It swallowed up its brethren and gained a greater power. Antharas, whose heart was filled with innate cruelty and madness of a Dust Rider, appointed him as the Valley's Eradicator and commanded him to build the Tower of Corpses.

skills.name: 84 level Raid Boss
skills.description: In order to gather monsters that would protect its territory, Antharas created countless sacrifice victims. The Bleeding Fly was enchanted by the stench of corpses and came up above ground. This nobility of purgatory, who feeds on the blood of hatred and fear, called itself the Gatekeeper of Antharas, and it took its place on one side of the Valley where there is an endless stream of reckless challengers.

skills.name: 84 level Raid Boss
skills.description: A Drake warrior that was once called the right wing of Antharas in battle. During the war against the gods, it lost two of its wings to injury and fell into a deep part of Purgatory. However, it was recently awakened by Antharas's call. It hold a deep grudge against the gods, especially Einhasad, and it believes that only the darkness of Shilen can bring rest to the world.

skills.name: 84 level Raid Boss
skills.description: It was once the subordinate of the Dark Dragon Skelus. It was one of the nobility of Purgatory who resided deep inside. But it came above ground at Antharas's calling. It protects the Nest of Antharas, and it also informs Skelus about the area's developments. When it was in Purgatory, it was called "Hell's Corpse Detonator" because of its sinister pleasure in making its comrades explode.

skills.name: 84 level Raid Boss
skills.description: A monsters summoned from Purgatory by the demon Maluk in exchange for one finger. As part of their agreement, Maluk presented an endless supply of hunting prey. The Spike Slasher accepted the proposal and came above ground with its subordinates in tow from Purgatory.

skills.name: 84 level Raid Boss
skills.description: The monster was created by the demon Maluk by joining a high-level demon with a dragon. It possesses the advantages of both demons and dragons. Maluk offered this exceptional creature to Antharas. Antharas fed its blood to the Muscle Bomber and appointed it as the Valley's Watcher.

skills.name: 85 level Raid Boss
skills.description: They say that this monster was created through the fusion of a human hero's body, who opened the Gate of Purgatory, and the spitefulness of countless monsters. However, this rumor is not confirmed. In any case, it has come above ground at Shilen's command, and it watches over the dragon's dungeon as an aide of Antharas. It possess exceptional abilities, and it is uniquely rational and cold-hearted. As such, it supposedly gives good assistance to the tyrant Antharas.

skills.name: 85 level Raid Boss
skills.description: A purgatory monster sent to Antharas by Shilen. The Behemoth Leader who came above ground was filled with uncontrollable madness as soon as it was unshackled. It killed countless monsters and eventually even tore off some of the flesh of Antharas, its master. Antharas burst into laughter at its foolish actions, and he cast a spell so that it would guard the Essence of Antharas, which maintains the dungeon's barrier.

skills.name: 85 level Raid Boss
skills.description: A Knight of Purgatory who has long assisted Antharas, together with the Black Dagger Wing.  During the war against the gods, it broke both arms and fell into a deep slumber within Purgatory. It recently awakened at Antharas's call. When the Dragon Beast appeared above ground, Antharas sliced off his own flesh in order to create its two arms. Then, he made it guard the dragon's dungeon.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 97
skills.description: The earth dragon whose name is synonymous with ferocity on the continent of Aden. It was buried deep underground for a long time. But after Shilen's awakening, the rain of blood permeated down and it came back to life. Now, its role is to destroy the lifeforms that seek the location of the Seal of Shilen.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 97
skills.description: Fused mutant created by Embryo upon capturing the power of the Seven Signs, through the authority of darkness received from Shilen. Harp is the prototype that was created after countless experiments. It's body's left side contains powerful magic and its right side physical power to make it a complete fighting machine. It protects the entrance to the Altar of Shilen.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 96
skills.description: One of the four disciples created in Embryo by their leader Etis van Etina through the power of the Seven Signs. It is twins with another disciple, Maliss. She is a Magus with the power of the Seal of Vengeance. She protects the Altar of Shilen and guards her power.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 96

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 98
skills.description: Beleth's minion. In order to block external power for attacking the Witch Parme, Beleth summoned the twin monster Veridan from the edge of hell and placed it at the Emerald Square in the Crystal Caverns. The monsters there have no sense of self. They only exist and respond. It obediently follows Beleth's command.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 98

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 98

In order to block external power for attacking the Witch Parme, Beleth summoned the Michaela from the edge of hell and placed it in the Coral Garden in the Crystal Caverns. Despite her beautiful appearance, she enjoys to kill in a vicious manner. It can distinguish between good and evil.

skills.name: Trasken
skills.description: A messenger from hell that was sent to the physical world in order to help complete the resurrection of Shilen. Hell's Gate. It kills by dazzling the lifeforms, then puts them into its mouth to send to Shilen in the realm of darkness.

skills.name: Raid Boss - Level 92
skills.description: Shilen's tenth lord. It is the leaders of the fairies that have fallen by the influence of the "Decaying Darkness." It has 80% of its sense of self, and it comes back to its senses now and again. The Fairy Settlement is filled with evil energy through its influence.
